description: This file defines a plugin for calculating inter-rater reliability using Cohen's Kappa, specifically for the BORIS behavioral coding software. It includes a function to compute Cohen's Kappa scores between different observers based on their coded behaviors over time intervals, with user input for rounding precision.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Calculates Cohen's Kappa for inter-rater reliability between different observers based on their coded behaviors in a DataFrame.
